76: GEMARA. “Out of the money that he was bought for” - this verse is written regarding a Hebrew slave who is sold to an idolator; [the passage containing it begins:] "If a resident alien among you has prospered." (Leviticus 25:47)

Since all of the acquisitions - of an idolator are performed [only] with money; "drawing" of movable property is only stated regarding Jews, as is written "from your neighbor's hand" (Leviticus 25:14) -- until it is drawn from hand to hand. Therefore, [a gentile] can acquire a slave with money.
